title: Trusted contacts
intro: People you trust. When a check looks risky, warn them with one tap, or call them first.
emptyBody: Add a family member or friend below. Their number is saved only on your device unless you sign in.

add.title: Add a contact
add.name: Name
add.phoneHint: Include the country code, for example +95.

footnote.synced: Your contacts are synced to your account.
footnote.local: Your contacts are saved on this device. Sign in to keep them if you change phone.

errors.permission: Allow access to contacts to pick someone, or type their number below.
errors.noNumber: That contact has no phone number.
errors.openFailed: We could not open your contacts. Type the number below instead.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number with 6 to 15 digits.
errors.duplicate: That number is already in your list.

warn.title: Warn someone you trust
warn.body: This opens a text message with the warning. You choose whether to send it.
